caption: The drawing depicts a decorative plate viewed from the top and from the side, rendered in pencil on an off-white or light beige background. The plate has a scalloped edge, forming a series of rounded projections around its circumference. The top view shows a central circular area with a geometric grid pattern consisting of interlocking squares or rectangles, each separated by double lines. Surrounding this central area is a wide border filled with swirling, scroll-like ornamental designs and small dot details. The side view, located below the top view, shows the profile of the plate, revealing a relatively shallow depth and a gently sloping rim. The side of the plate is decorated with a continuous scroll motif. The drawing is enclosed in a rectangular border, and the name “MARIE FAMLILARO” is inscribed in small text close to the lower right of the central composition. In the bottom right corner outside the border, there are small notes with measurements and the indication “DRAWN ACTUAL SIZE.” The overall color of the drawing is monochrome (gray pencil lines on an off-white background).
title: Honey Dish
